traditional: Action and heat combined with growth and fortune. One benefic, one malefic: the benefic tempers the malefic.

modern.blend: Energy meets expansion. Strong drive, confidence, and enthusiasm, sometimes to the point of recklessness.
modern.harmonious: High energy directed toward real accomplishment.
modern.hard: Shortened temper and patience, and energy scattered across one ill-considered pursuit after another.
modern.business: Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
